releaseNotes:
GIZTV 1.53.0 is a fresh install, not an update.

This build has a new app identity, so Android will not install it over your current
GIZTV. Updating from inside the app stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app."

To move across:
1. Uninstall your current GIZTV.
2. Download the APK from this release page and install it.

Watch history, My List, and resume positions do not carry over. Updates after this one
install themselves as usual.

Also in this release: posters and artwork load again throughout the app.
